intro.text: A young Arelene lordling, second son of a minor baron, whom the gyorn Hrathen courts as a convert to Shu-Dereth.

items.text: Ramear was among the young nobles Hrathen tried to win over to Shu-Dereth. He was willing to convert, but only for real rewards, and asked for assurances. Once Hrathen gave them, Ramear went away to think, and Hrathen judged him won, planning to meet him alone with a firmer promise.

appearance.text: Hawk-faced, with the strong nose typical of Arelenes.

personality.text: Shrewd and blunt, he asks outright what he will get, and makes sure the benefits are concrete. He shows little concern that converting means turning against his own country.
